problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual infrastructure budget across 17 different project categories to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The profile for each project category is as follows:  
* Category A: benefit score 0.046, impact factor 0.063, allocation limits [0.028, 0.859]  
* Category B: benefit score 0.155, impact factor 0.285, allocation limits [0.034, 0.584]  
* Category C: benefit score 0.187, impact factor 0.141, allocation limits [0.059, 0.502]  
* Category D: benefit score 0.092, impact factor 0.246, allocation limits [0.048, 0.558]  
* Category E: benefit score 0.075, impact factor 0.064, allocation limits [0.067, 0.522]  
* Category F: benefit score 0.198, impact factor 0.027, allocation limits [0.010, 0.834]  
* Category G: benefit score 0.167, impact factor 0.063, allocation limits [0.006, 0.900]  
* Category H: benefit score 0.020, impact factor 0.230, allocation limits [0.075, 0.790]  
* Category I: benefit score 0.033, impact factor 0.085, allocation limits [0.001, 0.865]  
* Category J: benefit score 0.145, impact factor 0.272, allocation limits [0.058, 0.699]  
* Category K: benefit score 0.114, impact factor 0.129, allocation limits [0.099, 0.527]  
* Category L: benefit score 0.138, impact factor 0.192, allocation limits [0.010, 0.334]  
* Category M: benefit score 0.152, impact factor 0.191, allocation limits [0.052, 0.514]  
* Category N: benefit score 0.051, impact factor 0.262, allocation limits [0.001, 0.498]  
* Category O: benefit score 0.087, impact factor 0.058, allocation limits [0.060, 0.360]  
* Category P: benefit score 0.147, impact factor 0.095, allocation limits [0.099, 0.574]  
* Category Q: benefit score 0.056, impact factor 0.120, allocation limits [0.076, 0.719]  

Each category must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all categories must equal the entire budget. To ensure adequate support for essential services, the subset of high-priority categories, denoted by L = {L}, must collectively receive at least 0.020 of the total budget. Additionally, the overall impact index of the portfolio must not exceed 0.202, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.101. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
